notes.title: REMOVING A BUG ON STEAM...
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, Let's talk...

As I continue my Game Development path there is one lingering bump in the road that I shudder when anyone mentions it... GiAnt. "A great concept, that never lives up to it's promise." That was once a review of GiAnt, and it's honesty is spot on.

GiAnt was the first game I ever released under the 'Wreck Tangle Games' name, and although it will always remain in my heart, it's also become a bit of a dampener when the 'Wreck Tangle Games' name creeps up in conversation. It was a game that possibly I shouldn't have released, I should have saved it as a practise run before the next game became the first release. 

I learnt so much from GiAnt, true, but as my game development path continues to get stronger, I don't think GiAnt expresses my abilities as a developer now. If a new player found GiAnt first, I am damn sure that they wouldn't play any more Wreck Tangle's games.

Therefore I have made the decision to remove GiAnt from Steam, and any other store it is featured on.

This has been a hard decision, but I truly believe it's the right one.

For everyone who has bought GiAnt, thank you so much for giving a small indie developer a chance. Game Development has become my life in the last few years, and I have no plans on slowing up!

Here's to WTG's future releases.

Orion

notes.title: **MAJOR ANNOUNCEMENT** REVERTING TO EARLY ACCESS and APOLOGIES
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First off, thank you to everyone who has bought the game so far! You are all stars! And I appreciate you all!

It has come to mine and Valves attention that the Game has issues. A lot of you are writing emails to me and writing on the hub with quite a few problems with the game, whether it be bugs, issues with the mechanics or just plain anger at how difficult GiAnt is. I think it is clear that this game isn't quite correct yet.

When you are a solo developer and you work on a game every single day for a year, I believe you become quite blind to problems in your own game (this is why major games company hire testers), so after testing 480+ times myself I thought it was done... But it is far from! You have all made it clear that this game has great potential but it falls down on itself! And I just can't let that happen!!

So now... I am asking you all to be my Testers. This game isn't MY game any more! It is OUR game! 

I apologise to anyone who has bought the game so far and is unhappy, I hope me now changing to Early Access doesn't make you think I planned this, or I cheated you out of a sale! My mind is far from those thoughts, I have just decided to start again with you, the community. I hope you all understand and can help make this game everything it could be...

Thank you all for your understanding!

Let's make this Classic..


Kind regards,

Adam

notes.title: UPDATE 1 - Fixed death, candy and graphics
notes.notes:
2 days since release and you have all been very helpful in pointing out some issues with the game. 

Death -The main one being the death script being completely broken. When you died, it would not restart the level, rather forced you to exit the whole game. This has now been rectified. 

Tutorial screen - when you start the Garden level a quick tutorial screen comes up, but this was very messy. I have cleared this up and made it easier to understand.

Candy - People have been getting confused when there candy goes missing because an enemy ate it... This was a good idea on paper, as these candy points were going to add up at the end of the level/game. I have taken this feature out for now until it is more refined. Enemies now CANNOT eat your candy. So six candies per level to open the exit, should always be 6.

Lastly some graphical fixes, mainly to reflections.

Please - If you find any issues, bugs, crashes, problems - Let me know, I will do my best to fix any issues in the next update. Thanks again!
